final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Abitazioni adibite a residenza con occupazione saltuaria'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 50
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the property located near healthcare services. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75. Relevant for a residential senior care facility (RSA).

User prefers energy class D or better. Translated to all classes from D upward (A1-A4, B, C, D). Energy class is used because the user did not mention consumption. Area (1,600 sqm), capacity (30 people), Turin location and proximity to healthcare are not energy requirements and are excluded.

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a direct >= threshold on surface_area. The capacity of 30 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold from the RegulatoryAgent is available. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to healthcare services are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are handled elsewhere. Turin is a geographic place, so comune_code is not set, since it is a cadastral code that the user did not supply.
